capabilities: Apply CSS classes to views based on folder path
Apply CSS classes based on note tags
disambiguation: Not a note classifier; it only attaches CSS classes to views so CSS snippets can target them.
extras: The README states the plugin is in maintenance mode: bugs and PRs are still reviewed but no new features will be added, and the author is open to handing it off.
intentEvidence: as if you had added them in a cssClasses YAML key, based on a note's path and tags
problem: Styling different folders or tagged notes requires manually adding a cssClasses key to every note, which is tedious across a large vault.

relations.evidence: by using the BRAT plugin with repository nathonius/obsidian-auto-class

summary: Applies CSS classes to Markdown views automatically based on a note's path or tags, as if set in a cssClasses YAML key.
